about_the_game:
The Pre-Alpha Demo of Times of Survival is Live!
This is a work-in-progress build — so you may encounter bugs, missing features, and some rough edges.

The Demo includes:

Single player experience for the player.

Single playable mission with base defense

Content:

- Around 60 minutes of immersive gameplay

- Survival and craft mechanics

- 5 types of different zombies

- 3 types of range weapons

- 3 types of melee weapons

We’re building this game with the community, and your feedback means everything to us.

If something breaks (or you just have thoughts), let us know — join our Discord!

Immerse yourself in the dark post-apocalyptic world of Times of Survival, where catastrophe has pushed humanity to the edge of extinction. Lead a group of survivors, battle hordes of mutated zombies, and rebuild destroyed settlements. Your mission is not just to survive but to restore hope for the future of humanity!

Don’t miss release date! Wishlsit now!

Cooperative Gameplay

Team up with up to 8 friends and fight zombies together. A diverse skill tree system allows for the creation of effective teams.

Epic boss fights and hardcore Souls-like combat

Forget about simple "tanky" zombies. Face unique bosses that demand strategy and teamwork.

Every enemy is a deadly threat. Study their attacks, use the environment to your advantage, and rely on your skills. The status effect system requires a tactical approach and the use of special items.

Earn valuable rewards for victory, unlocking new locations and items.

Fortify your Base and Manage Settlement

Rescue survivors, build shelters, and watch your settlement grow and evolve. Defend your home from zombie hordes using traps and fortifications, but dont forget to bring supplies, your settlement desperately need it.

Skill Tree & Customization

Choose your playstyle with an extensive skill tree and deep character customization. Choose abilities, upgrade weapons, and develop unique builds to suit your strategy. Interact with factions to gain exclusive perks, blueprints, and rare items.

Interactive Environment

Use the environment in combat: collapse towers, set traps, and unleash natural disasters against your enemies.

High Replayability

Every session is unique thanks to the procedural generated system: levels, enemies, items, NPCs, and more. Create diverse character builds and experiment with different tactics.

Global events and seasons add variety to the gameplay.

Global Progression

Your actions matter. Witness how your decisions shape the world map and the fate of humanity. Unlock new biomes, events, and missions as you progress through the story.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent depictions of violence, blood, and gore.
Players will engage in intense combat against zombie enemies using firearms and melee weapons. The game features graphic visual effects including dismemberment, blood splatter, and the destruction of undead bodies.

There are no depictions of sexual content, drug use, or self-harm. However, the overall tone of the game is dark and survival-focused, with themes of desperation and violence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600XT
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Times of Survival is a co-op zombie survival game with souls-like inspired combat system, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Fortify your base, fight hordes of zombies and battle epic bosses. Explore, craft, and master punishing combat while building your settlement and leading survivors to hope.
